summary: The fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in instruments in its underlying index or in instruments that have economic characteristics similar to those in the underlying index. The underlying index is designed to measure the equity market performance of listed companies with high revenue exposure to the Chinese government's "One Belt, One Road" initiative, as determined by the provider of the underlying index.
